sloka: तेषामधिष्ठितानां तैर्वानरैः पर्वतोपमैः।मुखेभ्यो रुधिरं रक्तं हयानां समवर्तत ।। ६.९०.५१ ।।
transliteration: teṣāmadhiṣṭhitānāṁ tairvānaraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ।mukhebhyo rudhiraṁ raktaṁ hayānāṁ samavartata ।। 6.90.51 ।।

translations.english: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.
